## Description

New page /hospitals: "Every site, department and doctor on one system." with single sign-on, central reporting, insurance e-claims and a patient app under the hospital's brand, records kept in country; the security and compliance blocks and "What hospitals get". Main CTA "Talk to our hospital team" goes to /demo. Features that are not built yet are described as planned, never as available.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the page, when it renders, then no feature is presented as available that the product does not have (each block says "planned" where it is not built).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given JavaScript is off, when the page loads, then it renders fully; axe is clean in en, hi and ar; Arabic is right to left.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
